### 1. Request, authorisation, simulator role
Lorraine Dvorak asks to pay off "my August imaging bill" in full today in one payment. Target object: the Aug 24 imaging visit at Grand Chute. Authorisation: she says "go ahead and do whatever is needed" if something must be posted first; she runs the payment herself by bank draft ("you will pay from your checking account"). Simulator is passive: gives DOB 1971-05-09 + ZIP 54914 on request, calcium-scan waiver and the January denial only if asked.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse
Act now. Identity: `verify_patient_identity` with DOB + ZIP -> "Identity confirmed". Account `51b5aff1-...` returns `financial_class: COMMERCIAL`, `variant_name: Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account`, `status: patient_due`, `first_statement_date: 2026-10-09`, `patient_balance: 1464.0`. Prompt-pay eligibility (prompt_pay_discount_policy, prompt_pay_terms): window 30 calendar days from 2026-10-09 (payment 2026-10-16 is day 7); minimum balance 75.00 met; ACH bank draft eligible; no charity adjustment (assistance case `charity_applied_total 0.0`), no payment plan ("No payment plans found"), no prior prompt-pay adjustment.

### 3. Object and rows
Narrowest object: account 51b5aff1 (the other account 5c833c82 is closed, Nov 2025 clinic). Rows: charge lines MRI rev 0610 2640.00, CT rev 0350 418.00; liability postings DEDUCTIBLE 1150.00, COINSURANCE 46.00, NONCOVERED_SERVICE 418.00 (`3703befd-...`, 2026-10-03, claim 0d58098f); POINT_OF_SERVICE payment 150.00; one SUMMARY_STATEMENT 2026-10-09 via PATIENT_PORTAL. Other-product rows: assistance case hardship tier (Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL)), `status denied`, `denial_reason INCOME_ABOVE_LIMIT`, `determination_date 2026-01-20`; Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate b9a956ef linked to the account, `issued_date 2026-08-13`, `scheduled_service_date 2026-08-24`, `estimate_total_usd 996.0`.

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Non-covered discount (noncovered_discount_calculation): "the patient class's uninsured discount percent ... of the non-covered amount, rounded half-up"; Imaging & Lab = 55 and "Insured patient's non-covered services eligible: yes" (uninsured_discount_schedule). Non-covered amount 418.00. Tiers:
- noncovered_amount_size_bands: 418.00 in "at least 250.00 but below 1000.00" -> +5.
- covered_visit_noncovered_item_points: MEDICALLY_NECESSARY, deductible+coinsurance+copay 1196.00 > 0 -> +2.5.
- deductible_burden_points: deductible 1150.00 >= 1000 -> floor(1150/250)=4 -> +4.
- imaging_site_of_service_points: MRI 0610 and CT 0350 lines, facility Grand Chute -> +5.
- hardship_denial_allowance_noncovered: most recent determination = hardship-tier denial, income above limit, 269 days before 2026-10-16 -> +5.
- insured_estimate_surprise_allowance: issued 08-13 on/before service date 08-24; 418.00 > 15% x 996.00 = 149.40 -> +5.
Combined 81.5 percent x 418.00 = 340.67 (cap 418.00 not reached). Fall-back (computation doc alone): 55% x 418.00 = 229.90.
(b) Insured payoff (insured_payoff_amount_calculation): balance standing after (a) = 1464.00 - 340.67 = 1123.33 (tool return "new balance: 1123.33"). Base prompt-pay percent 10 (Imaging & Lab). Tiers:
- insured_payoff_days_to_pay_schedule: 2026-10-16 minus 2026-10-09 = 7 -> +4.
- insured_payoff_liability_size_points: all liability postings 1614.00 -> +1.
- insured_payoff_noncovered_share_points: 418/1614 = 25.9% -> +1.
- insured_payoff_paperless_allowance: latest summary statement PATIENT_PORTAL -> +1.
- check_in_payment_allowance_insured: POS total 150.00 -> +0.75.
- insured_estimate_variance_credit: cost-sharing 1196.00 vs tolerance 996.00 x 1.15 = 1145.40, excess 50.60, credit 0.5 x 50.60 = 25.30.
Combined 17.75% x 1123.33 = 199.39; payoff = 1123.33 - 199.39 - 25.30 = **898.64** (prompt-pay discount posted by the tool = 224.69). Fall-back (no factor, prerequisite done): 1123.33 - 112.33 = 1011.00; "do only the payoff" (no non-covered discount): balance 1464.00 base.

### 5. Tool sequence
find_customers -> verify_patient_identity (agent) -> find_encounter_accounts / find_encounter_transactions / find_assistance_cases / find_price_estimates (reads) -> unlock_agent_discoverable_tool `post_noncovered_line_discount_93cdc726` -> call it (customer_id a21cebc7-..., encounter_id 51b5aff1-..., source_txn_id 3703befd-... [the only, hence most recent, non-covered posting], amount 340.67) -> unlock_user_discoverable_tool `pay_insured_balance_in_full_a10a8aeb` handed to the customer (owner user) -> customer pays 898.64, ACH_BANK_DRAFT. Terminal: balance 0.00, account closed. Verified the agent writes through db_query (returns quoted above).

### 6. Problem tree (visible only)
- Root: insured payoff (customer's own write). Its hub (insured_account_payoff_in_full) "When the amount is fixed": "The insured payoff amount is fixed only after an uninsured discount stands against one of the account's non-covered-service liability postings, on a patient class that grants that discount." Records: account has a NONCOVERED_SERVICE posting 3703befd with no UNINSURED_DISCOUNT adjustment pointing at it; class Imaging & Lab grants it ("yes"). State unmet.
- Hop 1 (state-derived): searching "uninsured discount ... non-covered-service liability postings" finds noncovered_liability_uninsured_discount_posting: "the non-covered amounts a payer released to the patient receive one uninsured discount adjustment ... sourced to the account's most recent non-covered-service liability posting"; its tool books "kind UNINSURED_DISCOUNT ... pointing back to the non-covered patient-liability posting". That write brings the state about. The discount doc carries no prerequisite sentence of its own -> leaf.
- Order: non-covered discount, then payoff. Direction: payoff waits on discount.
- Counter-proof "do only what she asked": paying 1464.00-based payoff violates the hub's "fixed only after" sentence; the state is visibly unmet in the records.
- Closest alternatives excluded: self-pay payoff rule ("An account of any other financial class is outside this sentence"; account is COMMERCIAL); coverage-terminated discount (no COVERAGE_TERMINATED posting); calcium-scan waiver is persona colour with no visible rule; deductible/coinsurance never discounted ("deductible, coinsurance and copay amounts never receive it").
- No hop pre-solved: the hub names no other tool; the discount doc does not mention the payoff.
